options.prompt: One concept art that fixes the look of the whole game 'Kitchen Riot'. Art style, identical for every asset in this game: Casual theme - chunky rounded vector outlines, glossy highlights, flat colour fills with at most two shading steps, no gradient, no airbrush, no texture noise, no visible brush strokes. Viewpoint: pure 2D side view, camera level with the characters, never top-down or three-quarter. Format: landscape 16:9 (game target 1920x1080), fully opaque background, floor line fixed at the bottom 20 percent of the frame. Background is a kitchen kept low saturation (25 percent or less) and lightness 75 to 85 percent so it separates from the characters; the chef, enemies and bosses use bright high-value colours. Character rules: the player is a two-heads-tall chibi chef (head plus two legs, white coat, chef hat) facing right; enemies are bodiless rolling fruit heads; bosses are giant fruit with eyebrows and teeth about 1.75 times the chef's height. Show the size hierarchy accurately. No text, no watermark, no pixel art, no photographic texture. Subject: A single concept art of a 2D side-view casual roguelite action game 'Kitchen Riot'. Casual style: rounded vector outlines, glossy highlights, flat colors, no gradients or airbrush. Scene: a kitchen battle room seen from the side, floor line at the bottom 20% of the frame, low-saturation kitchen counters and lit stove in the background. In the foreground a two-heads-tall chibi chef (head plus two legs, white coat and chef hat) facing right holding a kitchen knife, fighting rebel fruit heads without bodies rolling toward him: an apple (melee), a watermelon (large, tank), a banana (ranged, throwing peel). On the far right a giant angry pumpkin boss about 1.75 times the chef's height with eyebrows and teeth. Show size hierarchy clearly, bright high-value palette for characters, muted background. Include a minimal HUD sketch: red HP gauge top-left, room number and a row of room-type icons top-center. Landscape 16:9, 1920x1080, opaque background.
